frontier.hypothesis: The residual is no longer a search problem: two independent byte-exact pure-C forms exist and the elimination is complete, so the next escalation-modality session should file a DECISION PACKET on the single decidable question - which sanctioned family, if any, covers a multi-write fresh local whose earlier reference is a real call argument (alt_anchor_e1.c) or a real condition read (candidate.c).
frontier.mechanism: The 2026-08-30 21:30 Judge ruling FAILed the construct as a first reach with no covering family, while explicitly not objecting to constructs (1) v0-as-tail-base and (3) the s3 join-block placement; the [s10b] theorem shows no single-write or existing-variable alternative exists.
frontier.next_probe: Do NOT re-search anchor sites. Carry the [s10b] theorem plus the two 0-scoring forms into the packet, and keep it a fidelity/routing question - a request to sanction a new family is in the auto-reject class.

frontier.hypothesis: Splitting the carrier into TWO variables, each written exactly twice (one anchored on the 0x1A88 argument carrying a0+3, one anchored elsewhere carrying 0x8000), probably also scores 0.
frontier.mechanism: Each tail scratch independently needs its own flow-time second-block reference; splitting does not reduce the write count below two per variable, so the family verdict is unchanged.
frontier.next_probe: Measure only if a future ruling distinguishes 2-write from 3-write carriers; otherwise skip, it cannot change the verdict.

frontier.hypothesis: A 'static inline' tail helper could make the base copy and the scratches multi-block through integrate.c's parameter pseudos, with no source-level variable reuse at all.
frontier.mechanism: integrate.c copies the callee body into the caller and creates fresh pseudos for the parameters; the parameter copy is set in the caller's block and read in the inlined body's blocks, which is a flow-time second-block reference.
frontier.next_probe: Spell the six tail stores as 'static inline void helper(s16 *p, s32 a0, s32 a1)' called once, and measure. Expect cse to fold the parameter copy (a plain 'p = s1' base copy is already known to be folded away, 107 insns), but it is the one untried structural shape left on the rederive ladder.

judge_constraints: No fresh (newly invented) local may be written more than once to serve as a register/allocation carrier, by any spelling or name; keep the s3 join-block placement and the v0 tail-base reuse and find the remaining anchor via an existing variable or a structural respelling.
